description: Checklist and lifecycle overview for new integrations.

description: Save flow, field_sync, If-Match, and validation dry-runs.

description: Launch, status changes, and draft vs live locking.

title: Flow schemas

title: Webhooks

title: API Reference
description: OpenAPI reference grouped by tag (read-only, Furnace-branded).

title: Lead added / updated
description: Single-lead changes and bulk import or add-to-campaign completions.

title: Lead removed
description: Single-lead deletes and bulk removal from one or all campaigns.

title: Enrollment pause / resume
description: Manual enrollment holds and bulk pause/resume completions.

title: AICategorizerNodeData
description: Reply classifier node. At most one per flow. Outgoing edges must use sourceHandle interested, neutral, or not-interested.

title: BatchCompletionWebhookPayload
description: Standard payload for async or sync bulk completion webhooks.

title: BulkMembershipActionResult
description: RPC result counts from sync membership operations.

title: Campaign
description: Campaign row as returned by the Furnace backend.

title: CampaignFlow
description: Directed acyclic graph (DAG) defining the campaign sequence. Consumed by flow save, validate, and optional `flow` on campaign create.

title: CampaignUpdate
description: Mutable campaign fields. Mailbox ids can replace the full set or be incrementally added and removed.

title: DataSenderNodeData
description: Webhook node that POSTs lead data to an external URL when a lead reaches this step. Supports merge variables in `payload`. See [CampaignFlow](/docs/reference/sc

title: EmailNodeData
description: Outbound email node with one or more A/B variants.

title: EmailVariant
description: One A/B variant of an email node. Variant ids must be stable UUIDs. Supports merge variables in `subject`, `template`, and `body_html`.

title: FlowEdge
description: Directed connection between two nodes. Categorizer outgoing edges must set sourceHandle to interested, neutral, or not-interested.

title: FlowNode
description: One node in the campaign flow graph. The data shape depends on type — see [LeadSourceNodeData](/docs/reference/schemas/LeadSourceNodeData/), [EmailNodeData](/do

title: FlowPosition
description: Builder canvas coordinates. Cosmetic; safe to change on live campaigns.

title: FlowUpdate
description: Canonical campaign flow payload for `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/flow`, `PUT .../flow` (deprecated), and `POST .../flow:validate`.

title: FlowValidateResult
description: Dry-run result from `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/flow:validate`. Shows normalized flow, validation issues, change classification, and lifecycle gate outcome.

title: FlowValidationIssue
description: One validation problem in `issues[]` from flow validate/save, or in `details[]` on `400 invalid_flow` errors.

title: ForwardRequest
description: Create a forward job for a specific message in the thread.

title: ImportJobCreate
description: Create an async bulk job. Poll `GET /v1/jobs/{id}` for completion.

title: Lead
description: Lead row scoped to a campaign.

title: LeadCreate
description: Create or upsert a lead. `email` is required. When the campaign defines custom lead fields, every key must be present in `custom_lead_data`.

title: LeadSourceNodeData
description: Configuration for the single required `leadSource` node. Declares merge variables and custom lead fields.

title: Mailbox
description: Mailbox row with sensitive IMAP/SMTP passwords removed from the response.

title: MailboxUpdate
description: Mutable mailbox fields currently support tag assignment only.

title: OpenApiDocument
description: The live OpenAPI document returned by `/openapi.json`.

title: Person
description: Account-scoped person rollup row from the people explorer.

title: ReplyRequest
description: Create a reply job for a thread message. When omitted, subject and recipient fields fall back to the target message.

title: ThreadUpdate
description: Partial thread update. All fields are optional.

title: WaitTimeNodeData
description: Delay node. `wait_duration_seconds` is the runtime source of truth; `duration` and `unit` are display fields derived on save.

title: Health check
description: Checks that the API runtime is alive and can reach the backing database.

title: OpenAPI document
description: Returns the live OpenAPI contract served by Furnace.

title: List campaigns
description: Lists campaigns in the authenticated account. Results are paginated and can optionally include soft-deleted campaigns.

title: Create draft campaign
description: Creates a draft native campaign. Optional `flow` is normalized and validated on write. See [CampaignFlow](/docs/reference/schemas/CampaignFlow/) and [Campaign q

title: Get campaign
description: Returns one campaign within the API key account scope.

title: Update campaign
description: Updates mutable campaign fields. Mailboxes can be replaced wholesale with `mailbox_ids`, or incrementally edited with `add_mailbox_ids` and `remove_mailbox_ids`

title: Delete campaign
description: Soft-deletes the campaign, stops enrollments, and tombstones campaign nodes. Smartlead campaigns remain read-only.

title: Update live campaign status
description: Changes status for a live campaign (`running`, `paused`, or `stopped`). Draft campaigns must use `POST /launch` instead. Emits campaign status webhooks.

title: List flow templates
description: Returns starter flow graphs for common campaign patterns.

title: Launch draft campaign
description: Launches a draft campaign after verifying that it has a name, flow, and at least one mailbox. Furnace backfills enrollments before switching the campaign to `ru

title: Pause enrollments
description: Manually pauses enrollments for the given global lead IDs in a native campaign and emits one `enrollment.pause_completed` batch webhook.

title: Resume enrollments
description: Resumes manually paused enrollments for the given global lead IDs. Requires campaign status `running`. Emits one `enrollment.resume_completed` batch webhook.

title: Get campaign flow
description: Returns the normalized campaign flow graph. If a campaign has no saved flow, Furnace returns an empty `{ nodes: [], edges: [] }` payload. See [CampaignFlow](/do

title: Update campaign flow (deprecated alias)
description: Deprecated alias of `POST /v1/campaigns/{id}/flow`. Prefer POST with optional `If-Match`.

title: Save campaign flow
description: Writes the canonical flow payload. Returns `flow`, `flow_revision`, and `field_sync`. Use `?dry_run=true` to validate without persisting. Optional `If-Match` he

title: Patch flow node content
description: Live content-only patch for supported node types (email, waitTime, dataSender).

title: Validate campaign flow
description: Dry-runs flow normalization, validation, and lifecycle gating without writing changes. See [FlowValidateResult](/docs/reference/schemas/FlowValidateResult/) and

title: Get lead fields
description: Returns the mapped standard lead fields and required custom lead field keys extracted from lead source nodes in the campaign flow.

title: Append lead field
description: Appends a custom lead field key to the campaign flow and preserves existing keys.

title: List campaign leads
description: Lists non-deleted leads for a campaign. Search matches email and name fields.

title: Create or upsert lead
description: Creates a lead or updates the existing non-deleted lead with the same campaign/email pair. This endpoint supports idempotent retries via `Idempotency-Key` and e

title: Get lead
description: Returns one active lead in the campaign.

title: Update lead
description: Updates mutable lead fields and emits `lead.updated`.

title: Delete lead
description: Soft-deletes the lead, stops its enrollments, cancels queued campaign message jobs, and emits `lead.deleted`.

title: Bulk sync leads
description: Synchronously imports or upserts up to 100 leads in a single request. Per-row lead webhooks are suppressed; Furnace emits one `lead.bulk_import.completed` batch

title: Queue async lead import
description: Queues an async import job for up to 1000 leads. Furnace allows at most 3 queued or running async jobs per account at a time. Per-row `lead.created` / `lead.upd

title: Create async bulk job
description: Creates an async job for any supported bulk operation. Poll `GET /v1/jobs/{id}` for completion. Furnace allows at most 3 queued or running async jobs per accoun

title: Sync add leads to campaign
description: Adds up to 100 existing account people to a campaign by `global_lead_id`. Emits one `lead.added_to_campaign.completed` batch webhook.

title: Sync remove leads from campaign
description: Removes up to 100 leads from a campaign by `global_lead_id`. Emits one `lead.removed_from_campaign.completed` batch webhook.

title: Sync remove leads from all campaigns
description: Removes up to 100 people from every campaign in the account. Emits one `lead.removed_from_all_campaigns.completed` batch webhook.

title: List account people
description: Returns the account people explorer page with filters, sort, and pagination.

title: Get person
description: Returns one account person and their campaign memberships.

title: Update person profile
description: Updates profile fields on all lead rows for the given global lead id.

title: List people in saved lead list
Add members to saved lead list
Remove members from saved lead list
Get async import job
description: Returns one async lead import job for the authenticated account.

title: List mailboxes
description: Lists active account mailboxes. Furnace strips `smtp_password` and `imap_password` before returning each mailbox. Results can be filtered by mailbox tags.

title: Update mailbox
description: Updates mailbox tag assignments. Mailbox profile and credential fields remain read-only on the Client API.

title: Get mailbox
description: Returns one mailbox without secret password fields.

title: List inbox threads
description: Lists inbox threads in the authenticated account. By default only threads with at least one inbound reply are returned.

title: Update thread
description: Updates thread category, conversation status, and/or read state. Category changes emit a `reply.categorized` webhook when configured.

title: List thread messages
description: Lists messages in the thread ordered from oldest to newest.

title: Create reply job
description: Creates an outbound inbox reply job. When `in_reply_to_message_id` is omitted, Furnace targets the latest message in the thread.

title: Create forward job
description: Creates an outbound inbox forward job for a specific message in the thread.

title: Set out of office
description: Marks a thread out of office and optionally schedules campaign resume.

title: Clear out of office
description: Clears out-of-office state for a thread.

title: Replace lead
description: Replaces the thread lead with a new contact and optionally queues a forward job.

title: Add thread tag
description: Assigns an existing account thread tag to the thread.

title: Remove thread tag
description: Removes a thread tag assignment from the thread.

title: List thread tags
description: Lists account thread tags available for assignment.

title: Get message job
description: Returns the status of an outbound inbox reply or forward job.

title: Cancel message job
description: Cancels a queued or failed outbound inbox message job.

title: Send message job now
description: Requests immediate send for a queued outbound inbox message job.

title: List block list
description: Lists block-list entries in the authenticated account.

title: Add block list entry
description: Creates a block-list entry for an email address or domain. If an identical entry already exists, Furnace returns the existing row instead of creating a duplicat

title: Delete block list entry
description: Deletes a block-list entry in the authenticated account.

title: Campaign stats
description: Returns daily and aggregate campaign stats. When `start_date` and `end_date` are omitted, Furnace defaults the range to campaign creation date through today.
